confidence_notes: Recent city price indexes broadly agree on meal, coffee and beer levels, while cocktail and wine prices vary by venue. Accommodation is a holistic estimate; reliable year-typical prices are especially uncertain in this remote, seasonal destination.
comparable_city_reasoning: San Pedro de Atacama should cost more for lodging than Antofagasta, Iquique and Santiago because of its remote desert-tourism demand. I estimate basic rooms above the supplied $41–55 range and three-star rooms near the upper end of Puerto Natales's $103 anchor.
